title: ShotTx
description: ShotTx is the tableau component of Shot, a concurrent automated theorem prover for higher-order logic (Church's simple type theory) on the BEAM. It implements a parallel, actor-based refutation search with iterative deepening, Skolemisation, primitive substitution and demodulation on top of ShotDs, ShotUn and ShotTo, and includes proof reconstruction, a TPTP benchmark runner and an ablation harness.
